notes.title: Feedback Patch - Alpha 0.40
notes.notes:
This patch is intended to address concerns submitted by players through the in-game feedback form. Please continue to provide feedback to help improve the game.

Paint:
- Players can now change materials and apply paints to their vehicle.
- Temporarily removed painting of individual parts.

Minimap:
- Increased minimap size by 20%.
- Correctly displays real-world coordinates of the map.
- Player and Enemy icons are now displayed above other icons.
- Enemy icons correctly align with the corresponding vehicle's forward direction.

Tutorial:
- Players can now retry the distance score challenge.

Levels:
New York City:
- Each enemy now has a unique weapon loadout.
- Environmental props have been reworked to prevent getting stuck under the vehicles and impeding their movement.
- Temporarily removed highly obstructive environmental props.
- Reduced memory requirements.

Grand Canyon:
- Removed some ground rock formations to prevent vehicles from getting stuck.

AI Enemies:
- AI is now better at avoiding obstacles.
- AI will no longer pursue or fire at targets when their line of sight is obstructed.

Time To Kill:
- TTK has been doubled for all vehicles (avg. HP increased from 100 to 200).
- Vehicles that previously had 2 primary weapons now have 1 primary weapon (this is to facilitate weapon rebalancing and prevent high-powered weapons from being abused on some vehicles).

Weapons:
- Added muzzle flash effects to all weapons.

Vulcan (Gatling): 
- Fire rate increased from 15RPS to 50RPS.
- Audio changed to replicate a real gatling gun and to be less obtrusive with the new fire rate.

Solo Gun:
- Increased damage from 15 to 20.
- Increased projectile velocity from 200 to 300.
- Decreased size of impact and heat distortion effects by 50%.

Sniper:
- Increased damage from 25 to 45.
- Increased burnout rate from 25 to 55.

Shot Gun:
- Increased damage from 1x20 to 2x20.
- Decreased burnout rate from 30 to 26.

Seeker:
- Increased damage from 7.5 to 20.
- Increased burnout rate from 10 to 20.
- Decreased trail effects by 50%.

Rail Gun:
- Increased damage from 4 to 10.
- Increased fire rate from 2RPS to 4RPS.
- Decreased burnout rate from 15 to 10.

Loading Screen:
- Added helpful information about hotkeys and weapon mechanics. Next patch will including rotating mini-tutorials to cover more aspects of the game that the tutorial doesn't.

Bugs:
- Fixed an audio bug that caused the vehicle to play unintended crash sounds.
- Fixed an audio bug that prevented audio slider settings from affecting vehicle sounds.

notes.title: VFX Content Update - Alpha 0.32
notes.notes:
Content:

 Projectiles impacting unarmored metal will create bullet holes/scorch marks and expose internal components for critical damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524656/d16fcbe8f27b0730a2c6bf66ba9379a5c49e5ae5.gif
 Able to penetrate unarmored doors to eliminate the driver and front bumper/hood to deal massive engine damage.
 Added 17 new death explosions that realistically react with surrounding light sources.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524656/b0796e3aecaf0f1453f65c55716631bdefa3c6f1.png

The next update will include widescreen resolution support, longer time-to-kill, y-axis inversion, weapon balance pass, and an audio effects pass.

notes.title: Content and Balance Update - Alpha 0.20
notes.notes:
Content:

 New urban map added: New York City

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524656/409baf705df917ebca715484809b4f5e445a83f9.png
Balance:

 Reduced size and opacity of dust trails and explosions by 50% to help with visibility.

 Enemy speed reduced by 50%.

notes.title: Content and Balance Update - Alpha 0.15
notes.notes:
Content:

 New vehicle added: Police Interceptor.
 Active Ability: Grapple hook. Can be used to close the distance or dismember your target.
 Passive Ability: Overtake. When passing a vehicle from behind, instantly destroy them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524656/4b44068828d7f648b5dfdc4b41998e9bbe02da1b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524656/85c95342622f9e1c7fc0acddf8c01622efcf2a00.png
Balance:

 Average vehicle weight increased from 1,600lbs. to 4,000lbs to reduce "floatiness".
 Traction increased by 33% across all surfaces.
 Shotgun damage reduced by 50% (10x5 to 5x5).
 Missile damage reduced by 40% (50 to 33).
 Enemies retreat when health falls below 25%.
 Enemy pursuit speed reduced by 33% - 50%.
